note: THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for 'which Asdamir version is currently PUBLISHED on nuget.org'.
This file records what IS published — never what is about to be. A csproj <Version> ahead of the
number here is the NORMAL pre-publish state (the next release is built but not pushed yet); a number
here ahead of nuget.org is a DEFECT (generated apps would pin a version that does not exist).
Everything else derives from this file — do not hand-edit the derived sites:
* src/Asdamir.Tools/Commands/AppCommand.cs  — the generated-app pins read PublishedVersions.* (compile
time; there are no version literals left in AppCommand.cs, and a test asserts that).
* docs/cli.md          — the <!-- published-versions:begin/end --> region is GENERATED.
* CHANGELOG.md         — the <!-- published-versions:begin/end --> region is GENERATED.
BUMP THIS FILE AT THE MOMENT OF `dotnet nuget push`, not at the csproj bump. PublishedVersionsGateTests
compares it to nuget.org in BOTH directions (Category=PublishedVersions), so a publish that forgets this
file goes red as 'PIN BEHIND NUGET' — the direction nothing used to watch, and the one that let Core
1.7.0 / Data 1.5.0 ship while `asdamir new app` kept pinning 1.6.0 / 1.4.0 for days.
Location rationale: it lives inside src/Asdamir.Tools/ (not packaging/) because packaging/ is NOT synced
to the public repo, so a manifest there could not be the compile-time source for the pins in the public
clone — it would need a second copy, which is the duplication this file exists to remove.
